attributes.note_text: Cases A, B, C1 and C2 are system-level scenario outcomes. Case C1 motivates thermal runtime measure SOTIF_RT_001; follow-up Case C2 assesses its limitation under low thermal contrast. Case A-SW is a contributing classifier output insufficiency linked to system Case A, not a second independent hazardous scenario. Validate the complete sensing, fusion, classification and warning chain, including any compensating mechanisms.

Case A-SW concerns a pose-dependent false-negative output during correct execution and contributes to system Case A. Its tasks isolate the SW component boundary. SW requirement IDs are allocated in ARXML DESC notes and trace to system requirements through the RST satisfies attributes. Implementation faults remain in the SW fault analysis.
Case B origin: visible sensing resolution. Healthy acquisition/FoV status is not proof that a small target can be recognized.

Case C2 assesses thermal contrast discrimination after runtime measure SOTIF_RT_001 adds LWIR sensing for Case C1. LWIR blockage, calibration and contrast estimates are separate from RGB status and require independent validation.
